frontmatter.name: banking-operations
frontmatter.description: Handles requests about bank balances, transactions, deposits, spending, and cash flow using read-only tools. Use for account-specific questions in English or Portuguese (saldo bancário, extrato, transações, gastos, depósitos). Use read-only tools only when the configured provider supplies account data; never present market data or mock fixtures as a real bank connection or account activity.

frontmatter.name: financial-assistant
frontmatter.description: Explains personal finance concepts and calculations, including budgeting, debt, savings, interest, credit, loans, and emergency funds. Use for general financial education and illustrative projections in English or Portuguese (educação financeira, orçamento, dívidas, juros, crédito, empréstimos, reserva de emergência). Use investment-analysis for investment-product comparisons and banking-operations for real account balances or transactions.

frontmatter.name: investment-analysis
frontmatter.description: Compares investment products and potential returns, including CDBs, government bonds, funds, ETFs, portfolio risks, and yield scenarios. Use for investment analysis in English or Portuguese (comparar investimentos, CDB, Tesouro Direto, fundos, ETFs, rentabilidade, carteira, risco, taxas de mercado). Use authorized `market_data` MCP tools for current or historical financial data. Disclose when data comes from local mock fixtures. Do not use for general budgeting or bank activity.

frontmatter.name: chart-visualization
frontmatter.description: Creates interactive financial charts from user data, authorized market data, or fictional demo fixtures. Use when the user asks to see spending or a portfolio, compare investment performance, or follow a trend visually, even if they do not name a chart type. Use this Skill alongside financial analysis when a visual is requested.
